title: Leaving the Doughboys, Mineral Wells transcriptions, and no drums
summary: He left the Doughboys full time around 1939-40 for school but kept playing afternoons and records. The bands still used no drums, only an occasional clarinet or trombone.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
